items.name: Bank select
items.label: BANK
items.text: Turn the rotary knob under the LCD to select one of the 9 banks (1–9).

items.name: Mute groups
items.label: A B C D
items.text: Press A, B, C or D to load a mute group; hold one for 3 seconds to store the current mutes.

items.name: Preview
items.label: PREVIEW
items.text: Hold it and press A, B, C or D to see which channels that group mutes.

items.name: Solo release
items.label: SOLO RELEASE
items.text: Removes all active solos across all channels in one step.
